item.title: 5 Types of Remote LPN Jobs
item.description: Did you know that LPNs can work from home? That’s right! Remote LPN Jobs are becoming more common with improvements in telehealth access and expanding programs for remote monitoring. As a remote LPN, you will deliver nursing care through digital technology, like telephone, video, and messaging.
